caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden frame with turned posts, painted in a pale, grayish-blue color. At the top of the frame is a black rectangular panel with gold text reading "1810." Below this is a large, round, scallop-edged sign hanging from two metal hooks. At the top of the round sign is a brown eagle with outstretched wings, clutching a red, white, and blue striped ribbon in its beak. The inner part of the round sign is divided into two main sections; the upper section shows a side view of a white sailing ship on blue water under a blue sky. The lower section contains three brown sheaves of wheat arranged horizontally, above which is an image of a brown plow. Beneath the round sign and still within the frame is another black rectangular panel with gold text reading "I. SPENCER." The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with all elements centered within the composition.
title: Tavern Sign
